theme: Excluding the worst without wrecking the tracking
title: ESG Screen: Excluding the Worst Without Wrecking the Tracking
strategies: equal-weight over eligible names (ignores weights and factors entirely)
proportional rescale of survivors' original benchmark weights (looks principled, but factor-blind: shifts sector/size exposure whenever the exclusion set is sector-concentrated)

sector-target water-fill: allocate weight to sectors to match the benchmark's sector exposure as closely as capacity allows (optimal for any PSD F once a sector's gap hits 0), then fill each sector pro-rata among its own eligible names -- substitutes within the factor, not across the whole universe

risk-priority rationing: when total substitution capacity cannot close every sector's gap, ration the shortfall across still-open sectors weighted by what THIS instance's factor covariance F actually charges for that sector's mismatch (F[k][k] plus its co-movement with the size factor), instead of spreading it blindly
